Welcome to Saline County
Official Website of Saline County in Nebraska. Your source for Information about Saline County Offices, Departments and Services. Cities and villages include Crete, DeWitt, Dorchester, Friend, Swanton, Tobias, Western, and Wilber.
The Saline County flag is a vibrant representation of the county’s heritage, natural features, and community spirit. The blue symbolizes the Big Blue River . At the center, a red heart honors the rich Czech heritage of the region. Radiating from the heart are eight yellow rays, each one representing one of the county’s eight distinct communities . The green in the design signifies the county’s deep agricultural heritage .
